open_questions.question: What is the actual root cause of 28% deal cancel/postpone, split by city?
Why has partner (Mada) data quality dropped - missing allotment/booking dates for 2-3 months?
Are FBMs actively cross-pitching customers already logged with another bank? What is the pitch success rate?
What is the measurable impact of DRE/BRE automation on FBM productivity?

risks: AOP FBM productivity target at 8.11 vs 14 - ~42% miss with no clear structural fix in sight
Sanction pool aging in Mumbai/Pune - builder CC/RERA delays causing M5/M6 TAT for direct allotment cases
Partner lead data quality degraded for 2-3 months - stale leads burning FBM capacity and inflating drop-off metrics
No formal contingency plan yet for tenured FBM simultaneous leaves - same failure mode can recur
May call recording gaps have corrupted first-call follow-up and talk-time reports
QL-to-login gap still 9 points below AOP target - DID and auto-dialer are the key bets, both unproven at scale
Training AOP escalation score at 63% vs 65-70% target - margin is narrow and new topics being added may dilute
meeting_dynamics: Raghu drove all the tough diagnostic follow-ups; other seniors were largely in response mode
Cause-and-effect not always closed - multiple drop-off causes identified but few with confirmed owners and timelines
FBM productivity miss (8.11 vs 14 AOP) received minimal discussion despite being the most significant AOP gap
Training presenter presented well but the AOP score gap was not stress-tested in the room
Rishabh's Monday outcome was accepted without defining what decision would follow the partner meeting
